PET ADDENDUM

Crestline Residential Partners LLC
340 Marlowe Court, City of Ashgrove

This Pet Addendum is the addendum named in section 10.1 of the Residential Lease Agreement between Crestline Residential Partners LLC and Theo A. Bramhall for Apartment 12C. It is signed before an animal enters the premises and runs for the rest of the term.

1. WHAT IS ALLOWED

1.1 The resident may keep up to two animals in the premises, and each one must be listed by name, species, and weight on the signature page of this addendum.

1.2 A dog over sixty (60) pounds at full growth is not permitted without the written consent of the landlord.

1.3 A service animal or an assistance animal is not an animal for the purposes of this addendum, and no fee in it applies to one.

1.4 An animal that is not listed on the signature page is not permitted in the premises, including an animal kept for a friend for a weekend.

2. FEES AND DEPOSITS

2.1 A nonrefundable pet fee of $600 per animal is due before the animal enters the premises, and pet rent of $75 per animal is added to each month's rent for the rest of the term.

2.2 The pet fee is not a deposit and is not returned at the end of the term, whatever the condition of the premises.

2.3 The pet fee and the pet rent are charged for each animal separately, so a household with two animals pays both twice.

3. CARE AND CONDUCT

3.1 The resident shall keep an animal on a leash or in a carrier in every common area of the building, including the lobby, the hallways, the stairs, and the lot behind the building.

3.2 The resident shall pick up after an animal on the grounds at once, and shall use the bins by the back door for that purpose.

3.3 The resident shall not leave an animal alone in the premises for more than twenty-four hours.

3.4 The resident shall have an animal treated for fleas twice a year and shall keep the receipts.

4. DAMAGE AND COMPLAINTS

4.1 The resident shall pay for damage an animal causes to the premises, to a common area, or to the grounds, at the contractor's invoice with no markup.

4.2 If the landlord receives written complaints about an animal from residents of two separate dwelling units, the landlord may end this addendum on fourteen (14) days written notice, and the animal must then leave the premises.

4.3 The resident may keep the lease after an animal has to leave under section 4.2, and the pet fee is not returned.

4.4 An animal that bites a person in the building must leave the premises at once.

5. ENDING THIS ADDENDUM

5.1 This addendum ends when the lease ends, or earlier under section 4.2.

5.2 The resident shall tell the landlord in writing within seven days of an animal leaving the premises for good, and pet rent for that animal stops at the end of that month.

5.3 Ending this addendum does not end the lease.
